pr.title: Add isTree_iff_connected_and_forall_edge_isBridge: characterize trees as connected and with all edges as bridges
pr.body:
### Description
This PR introduces a new theorem `isTree_iff_connected_and_forall_edge_isBridge` for the `SimpleGraph` structure, which characterizes trees in terms of their connectivity and the property that every edge in the graph is a bridge. This result helps further describe the structural properties of trees in graph theory.

### Theorem Added
- `isTree_iff_connected_and_forall_edge_isBridge`: A tree is connected and every edge is a bridge.

### Motivation
The addition of this theorem provides a characterization of trees, extending the understanding of how connectivity and acyclicity interact with edge properties, specifically with respect to bridge edges. This theorem can be helpful for future work involving graph structures and their properties in `SimpleGraph`.

---

Co-authored-by: Yiran Wang <qdu_wyr@163.com>

### 🚨 PR Title Needs Formatting
Please update the title to match our [commit style conventions](https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/commit.html).

Errors from script:
```
error: the PR title should be of the form
  abbrev: main title
or
  abbrev(scope): main title
```

<details>
<summary>Details on the required title format</summary>

The title should fit the following format:
```
<kind>(<optional-scope>): <subject>
```
`<kind>` is:

- `feat` (feature)
- `fix` (bug fix)
- `doc` (documentation)
- `style` (formatting, missing semicolons, ...)
- `refactor`
- `test` (when adding missing tests)
- `chore` (maintain)
- `perf` (performance improvement, optimization, ...)
- `ci` (changes to continuous integration, repo automation, ...)

`<optional-scope>` is a name of module or a directory which contains changed modules.
This is not necessary to include, but may be useful if the `<subject>` is insufficient.
The `Mathlib` directory prefix is always omitted.
For instance, it could be

- Data/Nat/Basic
- Algebra/Group/Defs
- Topology/Constructions

`<subject>` has the following constraints:

- do not capitalize the first letter
- no dot(.) at the end
- use imperative, present tense: "change" not "changed" nor "changes"
</details>

@@ -118,6 +118,15 @@ theorem isAcyclic_iff_forall_edge_isBridge :
     G.IsAcyclic ↔ ∀ ⦃e⦄, e ∈ (G.edgeSet) → G.IsBridge e := by
   simp [isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge, Sym2.forall]
 
+theorem isTree_iff_connected_and_forall_edge_isBridge :
+    G.IsTree ↔ G.Connected ∧ ∀ ⦃e : Sym2 V⦄, e ∈ G.edgeSet → G.IsBridge e := by
+  calc
+    G.IsTree ↔ G.Connected ∧ G.IsAcyclic := SimpleGraph.isTree_iff (G := G)
+    _ ↔ G.Connected ∧ (∀ ⦃e : Sym2 V⦄, e ∈ G.edgeSet → G.IsBridge e) := by
+      simpa using
+        (and_congr_right (fun _ =>
+          (SimpleGraph.isAcyclic_iff_forall_edge_isBridge (G := G))))
+
 theorem IsAcyclic.path_unique {G : SimpleGraph V} (h : G.IsAcyclic) {v w : V} (p q : G.Path v w) :
     p = q := by
   obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := p
